identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a Smart Campus Bot that fuses 'Ivy League Library' authority with 'Future Tech' intelligence.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix academic serif fonts with cybernetic neon accents.
Content is King: The answer is the hero.
Zoom In: Focus on the citation/source details.
Negative Space: Allow the text to breathe like a well-typeset book.

theme_strategy.name: The Intelligent Archive
theme_strategy.description: A dual-personality interface. Light mode feels like a high-end research journal. Dark mode feels like a futuristic command center.

headings.usage: All H1-H3 headings. Use font-weight 600 or 700.

body.usage: All paragraph text, UI labels, inputs.

usage_rules: Use Academic Teal for primary actions (Upload, Send).
Use Electric Indigo for AI-generated text highlights and active states.
Use Insight Coral sparingly for alerts or 'New Insight' badges.
NEVER use gradients for text. Use them only for subtle background glows.

layout.grid_system: The Bento Grid (Mode B: Control Room)

structure.chat_interface: Centralized column (max-w-3xl) with floating input bar.
structure.dashboard: Grid of cards for document stats (Uploaded, Processing, Ready).

glassmorphism.usage: Chat input bar, Sidebar, Toast notifications.
glassmorphism.classes: bg-white/80 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-lg

specifics.buttons: Uppercase labels, tracking-widest, text-xs, sharp corners.
specifics.cards: Flat background, 1px border, no shadow by default. Hover lifts slightly.
specifics.inputs: Minimalist, bottom border focus or full pill shape for chat.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to mimic paper grain.
decorations: Use thin 1px lines to connect sections (The 'Tracing Beam' effect).
Use ASCII art or simple geometric shapes for empty states.

media.image_style: High contrast, academic, or abstract tech.

images.description: Abstract blue network nodes, use for subtle background overlay.
Students studying in a modern library, use for welcome screen or empty state.
Professional woman, use for user profile or testimonial.

media.icons: Lucide React (default). Use thin stroke (1.5px) for elegance.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #1A1A1A on light bg, or #F8F9FA on dark bg.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include the new font families and color palette.
3. OVERRIDE SHADCN: Modify ui/button.jsx, ui/card.jsx etc. to match the 'Sharp & Technical' style (rounded-sm).
4. LAYOUT: Build the 'ChatLayout' with a sidebar and main chat area. Use the 'Bento Grid' for the document manager.
5. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
6. NO TRANSPARENT BG: Ensure headers and floating elements have a solid or blurred background.
7. FILE EXTENSIONS: Use .js and .jsx as per the project structure.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
